related.title: 奧卡里亞地熱電站
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合；奧卡里亞地熱電站改以兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration; Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations centers on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Theistareykir熱源與Olkaria兩相資源，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到奧卡里亞地熱電站，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以自然環境證據為起點，設計一項能區分「火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合」與「兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare theistareykir heat source with olkaria two-phase resources and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from natural-environment evidence and propose an observation distinguishing volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration from two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation, including uncertainty.

以自然環境證據為起點，設計一項能區分「火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合」與「乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare theistareykir heat source with geysers steam reservoir and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from natural-environment evidence and propose an observation distinguishing volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration from dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment, including uncertainty.

history.text: Þeistareykir 地熱工程的公開資料展示火山熱源、分期機組與環境整合的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Theistareykir geothermal engineering illustrate volcanic heat, phased units and environmental integration. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.
